newsitem.title: FRANCE: Blast hits holiday villa on island of Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Blast hits holiday villa on island of Corsica.

text.p: French police have rounded up 150 to 200 people for questioning in connection with a December 3 commuter train bombing in central Paris in which four people died, Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre said on Tuesday.
He said in a radio interview that investigators had found fingerprints on bomb parts and would identify those responsible for the blast "more quickly than you think".
